Class Asset

java.lang.Object
app.domain.Asset
public class Asset extends Object
The class that give the layout of the attributes and methods evolving around the asset that needs to be implemented or edited

  • Constructor Details

    • Asset

      public Asset(String assetTag, String name, String location, LocalDate purchaseDate, BigDecimal unitCost, int quantity, AssetStatus status, boolean assigned)
      Creates a new asset with the given properties.
      Parameters:
      assetTag - unique identifier for this asset
      name - descriptive name of the asset
      location - physical or logical location of the asset
      purchaseDate - date the asset was purchased
      unitCost - cost of a single unit of this asset
      quantity - number of units owned
      status - current lifecycle status of the asset
      assigned - whether the asset is currently assigned
